meaning:
battle, war
Aramaic equivalent: qe.rav (קְרָב "war" H7129)

elsewhere.note: But I counsel that all Israel be gathered together to you, from Dan even to Beersheba, as the sand that is by the sea for multitude; and that you go to battle…
which I have reserved against the time of trouble, against the day of battle and war?
He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.
Wisdom is better than weapons of war; but one sinner destroys much good.
Then Yahweh will go out and fight against those nations, as when he fought in the day of battle.
